The conference broadly covers learning representations, deep learning architectures, optimization and generalization, multimodal and generative models, reinforcement learning, theory and analysis of modern ML, efficient and trustworthy learning systems, and applications of representation learning across domains.

postings.conferenceName: 2026 17th International Conference on Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering 2026

Mechanical engineering and aerospace engineering topics; design, analysis and manufacturing; materials and structures in aerospace and mechanical systems; dynamics, control and robotics; thermal sciences and fluid-related topics; applied engineering technologies; and related theoretical and practical research areas included in the ICMAE technical program and submission tracks.

postings.conferenceName: 2026 10th International Conference on Material Engineering and Manufacturing 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 2026 10th International Conference on Material Engineering and Manufacturing

Call for papers topics include material engineering and advanced manufacturing; nanomaterials and composites; surface modification and coatings; structural and functional materials; metamaterials and intelligent surfaces; processing, fabrication and production technologies; characterization and testing; automation-related manufacturing themes; and broader interdisciplinary materials and manufacturing research.

postings.conferenceName: 28th ACM International Conference on Multimodal Interaction 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 28th ACM International Conference on Multimodal Interaction

The 2026 edition is held in Seoul, South Korea. The conference encompasses machine learning broadly, including supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning, probabilistic modeling, optimization, representation learning, deep learning, trustworthy ML, scalable systems, theory, and application-driven research across science and engineering.

The official site highlights broad interest in theoretical methods, experimental studies, production technologies, and practical applications involving advanced engineering materials and manufacturing systems. By combining these fields, the conference aims to encourage exchange on how materials behavior, mechanics-based analysis, and manufacturing innovation can be integrated to solve current engineering challenges. Mechanics, materials and manufacturing topics; advanced materials and structures; manufacturing technologies and production systems; mechanical behavior and analysis; materials processing; characterization and testing; design and modeling; engineering applications; and related interdisciplinary contributions spanning the conference's mechanics, materials and manufacturing focus.

postings.conferenceName: ACM International Conference on Multimedia Retrieval 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: ACM International Conference on Multimedia Retrieval

Multimedia retrieval and search; analysis and understanding of multimedia and multimodal data; social, lifelogging, and sensor data; multimodal fusion and integration; deep learning for multimedia retrieval; applications of multimedia search and understanding.

postings.conferenceSeries: 32nd International Conference on Nuclear Engineering
postings.conferenceText: The International Conference on Nuclear Engineering (ICONE) is a major recurring international conference on nuclear engineering, jointly supported by leading professional societies from the United States, Japan and China. Program comprehension; empirical evaluation of comprehension tools and techniques; human aspects of comprehension; collaborative and distributed comprehension; comprehension in the era of LLMs and AI-assisted programming; programming education and comprehension; cognitive theories and empirical studies; tool support for understanding software artifacts and evolution.

postings.conferenceText: The International Conference on Power and Energy Systems (ICPES) is a continuing international conference series for research and engineering developments in power systems, electrical energy technologies and related infrastructure. Pattern recognition; computer vision; machine learning; image processing; speech and natural language processing; sensor pattern processing; methods and applications spanning core and emerging areas of pattern recognition.

postings.conferenceSeries: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation
postings.conferenceText: ICRA 2026 is the IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation, one of the flagship international conferences in robotics and automation. The conference broadly covers robotics and automation, including robot perception and vision, motion planning, control, manipulation, human-robot interaction, autonomous vehicles, medical and service robotics, learning for robotics, multi-robot systems, and industrial automation.

postings.conferenceText: The 2026 12th International Conference on Robotics and Artificial Intelligence (ICRAI 2026) is an annual conference focused on the interaction between robotics technologies and artificial intelligence. Robotics topics include robot design and development, robot sensing and perception, motion planning, navigation, humanoid robotics, service robots, aerial robots, underwater robotics, multi-robot systems, industrial robotics, autonomous systems, control and optimization, human-robot interaction, computer vision for robotics, intelligent perception, machine learning for robotics, artificial intelligence methods in robotic systems, and related applications of AI in autonomous and intelligent machines.

postings.conferenceSeries: 15th International Conference on Renewable Energy Research and Applications
postings.conferenceText: The International Conference on Renewable Energy Research and Applications (ICRERA) is a well-established international conference series dedicated to renewable energy technologies, power systems, electrification and sustainable energy applications. Supercomputing and high-performance computing; parallel architectures and systems; scalable software and runtime techniques; performance analysis and optimization; workshops and related contributions in advanced computing systems.

postings.conferenceName: 24th IEEE International Conference on Software Architecture 2027
postings.conferenceSeries: 24th IEEE International Conference on Software Architecture
postings.conferenceText: ICSA 2027 is the 24th IEEE International Conference on Software Architecture and is presented on the official site as a premier forum for software architecture research and practice. Since 1998, the conference has brought together researchers, practitioners, and educators to exchange ideas, share experience, and shape the future of software architecture. A defining characteristic highlighted by the organizers is its working-conference tradition, in which interactive sessions connect researchers and practitioners around real architectural challenges and future agendas for the field. The 2027 edition will be hosted by CSIRO in Sydney, Australia, and continues this tradition in a context where AI-assisted development and rapidly changing implementation techniques are reshaping software engineering. The official theme for the research track is “The Enduring Role of Software Architecture in an Evolving Landscape,” with particular interest in how AI influences architectural design, decision making, and system evolution. Requirements & Architecture: stakeholder management and collaboration with other domains; linking architecture to requirements and/or implementation; linking architecture to spec-driven development; methods to address the intertwining of specification and design; sustainability, ethics, business, financial, and managerial aspects of software architecture. Architecture Design: model-driven architecture; component-based software engineering; architecture frameworks and architecture description languages; reusable architectural solutions and architecture knowledge management. Cloud-native Computing & Architecture: microservices and containerization; serverless platforms and novel forms of virtualization; event-driven architectures; observability and distributed tracing. Architecture Evaluation: evaluating quality aspects such as security, performance, reliability and evolvability; architecture conformance checking; real-time architecture observability and adaptation beyond static compliance; lightweight evaluation methods; new and emerging quality attributes, tactics and evaluation methods including energy consumption and environmental impact. Architecture & its lifecycle: automatic extraction and generation of software architecture descriptions; architecture in CI/CD and DevOps; refactoring and evolving architecture design decisions; agile and continuous architecting. Architecture & Architects: roles and responsibilities for software architects; training, mentoring, education and certification; equality, diversity and inclusion; state of the art and state of practice; architecture copilot for supporting architects. Architecture for specific systems: edge, fog and IoT systems; AI/ML/LLM-based systems; blockchains; cyber-physical systems; self-adaptive and autonomous systems; agent and multi-agent systems including agentic AI. Architecture & Generative AI: design assistance; comparing technologies and trade-offs; code generation from architecture designs; architectural design supported by generative AI; architecture principles for AI systems.

postings.conferenceText: IEEE IRI 2026 is the 27th edition of the International Conference on Information Reuse and Integration for Data Science. Hosted by CISPA in Saarbrücken, WiSec combines foundational methods with practical defenses and system-building work relevant to contemporary networked platforms. Wireless and mobile security; cellular and network protocol security; IoT and cyber-physical systems security; privacy in mobile and wireless systems; applied cryptography for wireless settings; authentication and access control; usable security and privacy; biometrics; attacks, measurements, and defenses for connected devices and platforms.

postings.conferenceText: The ACM Web Conference 2026, formerly known as the International World Wide Web Conference (WWW), is the premier annual forum for presenting and discussing advances in research, development, standards, and applications shaping the future of the Web. Since 1989, the conference series has served as a central meeting place for the web research community. The 2026 edition is held in Dubai, United Arab Emirates and features research sessions, posters and demos, a PhD symposium, workshops, tutorials, special tracks, industry activities, keynote talks, panels, and the co-located Web4All event. The conference broadly addresses web research, development, standards, and applications, including web systems, information access, social and semantic web technologies, web mining, data-driven web applications, user interaction, industry and deployment issues, and the broader technologies shaping the evolution of the Web.
